entry.title: Donut Theory 1.14.2
entry.summary: # Donut Theory 1.14.2 - Aligned front selectors to one or two knob columns, with consistent heights and spacing. - FREE/SYNC now sits directly above its Rate control on the performance and MOD pages. Motion Sync no longer occupies the section title. - Standardized the footer VOICE, Dice Target and input selector widths. - Added consistent list text/arrow padding and a compact TIME layout that leaves room for numeric units. - Original artwork, fonts, knob geometry, sound engine, 391 parameter def
